text: Sorry, this might be nothing. I'm a childminder and one of my girls (7) is staying over tonight while her mum works a night shift. I think she's had a mild cough most of the day. I just took her temperature and it's 39.3. The thing is she's not really herself. I'm not sure if I'm overreacting but she's quite hard to wake properly. When I did rouse her she sort of looked at me and didn't really answer like she normally would, then went straight back off and she feels all limp and heavy. Maybe she's just very tired? I didn't want to wake her mum over something silly but I'm not sure what's normal here.
